lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Hi, is this Daniel? This is Nina Cole from Harbor Street Arts Center. I'm calling about Saturday's neighborhood photo walk.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Sorry, what was that? I couldn't hear you.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: This is Nina Cole, from Harbor Street Arts Center.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Sorry, I didn't catch your last name.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Cole. C-O-L-E.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Thanks. Maya told me about the photo walk. Is it still at ten?

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: It starts at ten fifteen now.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Did you say ten fifteen or ten fifty?

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Ten fifteen—one-five.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Got it. Just to check, you mean we're not meeting at the café anymore?

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: That's right. Please meet us inside the arts center, by the front desk.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Let me make sure I've got this right: Nina Cole, Saturday at ten fifteen, inside the arts center by the front desk.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Great. Thanks for clearing that up.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Daniel?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Yes. Hi, Nina. Sorry I'm a few minutes late. My bus was late.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: No worries. We haven't started yet.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Great. Have you organized many of these walks?

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Yes. We organized six last year. Have you joined one before?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: No, I haven't, but I've taken photos around Riverton since I moved back. I used to take pictures much more often.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Nice. Are you still taking a lot of pictures?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I don't take as many anymore. Work's been busy, but I want to take more.

lines.speaker: Announcement
lines.text: Everyone, we're meeting in Gallery B.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Sorry, did she say Gallery B or D?

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Gallery B, right across from the front desk.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Got it. Thanks.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Come on. We should go in.
